stem: Bubbling air through different aqueous mixtures of $\text{CoCl}_2$, $\text{NH}_4\text{Cl}$ and $\text{NH}_3$ produces various complex ions with the general formula $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_{6-n}\text{Cl}_n]^{3-n}$.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Determine the oxidation state of the cobalt in these complex ions.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Name the **two** types of reaction undergone by the cobalt ions during the formation of these complex ions.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
Iron(III) forms complexes in separate reactions with both $\text{SCN}^-$ ions and $\text{Cl}^-$ ions.

$$\text{Fe}^{3+}\text{(aq)} + \text{SCN}^-\text{(aq)} \rightleftharpoons [\text{FeSCN}]^{2+}\text{(aq)}$$ equilibrium 1

$$\text{Fe}^{3+}\text{(aq)} + 4\text{Cl}^-\text{(aq)} \rightleftharpoons [\text{FeCl}_4]^-\text{(aq)}$$ equilibrium 2
parts.text:

parts.text:
An equilibrium can be set up between these two complexes as shown in equilibrium 3.

$$[\text{FeCl}_4]^-\text{(aq)} + \text{SCN}^-\text{(aq)} \rightleftharpoons [\text{FeSCN}]^{2+}\text{(aq)} + 4\text{Cl}^-\text{(aq)}$$ equilibrium 3

Write an expression for $K_{\text{eq3}}$ in terms of $K_{\text{stab1}}$ and $K_{\text{stab2}}$.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
The numerical values for these stability constants are shown.

$$K_{\text{stab1}} = 1.4 \times 10^2 \quad K_{\text{stab2}} = 8.0 \times 10^{-2}$$

Calculate the value of $K_{\text{eq3}}$ stating its units.
